title: meet-ai config
description: Settings for meet-ai, stored in ~/Meetings/.app/config.jsonc. Every key is optional; a missing key uses its default. Unknown keys are allowed and kept.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, so editors can autocomplete and check the file.

meetings_root.description: Folder where meetings are stored. A leading ~ means your home folder.

transcription.description: How speech is turned into text.

engine.description: Which speech-to-text engine to use. "auto" picks the best one for this Mac. Forcing an engine this Mac cannot run is an error, not a silent fallback.

model.description: Whisper model name, used when the whisper engine runs.

language.description: Spoken language of the meeting, as a language code.

live.description: Transcribe while the call is running. false = transcribe only after recording stops.

retention_days.description: Days to keep audio files after a meeting. 0 = delete immediately, -1 = keep forever.

warn_no_headphones.description: Warn when recording without headphones, since speakers can echo into the mic.

calendar.description: Where upcoming meetings are read from.

providers.description: Calendar sources to read. "eventkit" is the macOS Calendar app.

ics_urls.description: Calendar feed links (.ics), used by the "ics" provider.

refresh_minutes.description: How often, in minutes, to re-read the calendars.

detection.description: Signals used to notice that a meeting has started.

calendar.description: Use calendar events to spot meetings.

processes.description: Watch for running meeting apps, such as Zoom or Teams.

audio_activity.description: Watch for the mic and speakers being used at the same time.

min_attendees.description: Only treat a calendar event as a meeting if it has at least this many attendees.

agent.description: The agent CLI the app runs to write notes and tasks when a call ends.

harness.description: Which agent CLI to run. "none" = copy-prompt fallback: the prompt is put on the clipboard for you to paste into an agent yourself.

model.description: Model to use. Any model name the chosen CLI accepts.

binary_path.description: Full path to the agent CLI. Set this when auto-detect cannot find it; null = find it automatically.

auto_run.description: Start writing notes on their own when a call ends.

timeout_sec.description: Longest time, in seconds, one agent run may take before it is stopped.

tickets.description: Where tasks are synced to. The agent does the syncing through its own connections.

tracker.description: Issue tracker that tasks are synced to.

tracker_mcp.description: Name of the tracker's MCP server, exactly as the chosen CLI lists it. It is named in the Sync prompt; the app never calls it itself.

repos.description: Code repositories that tasks relate to.

default.description: Repository folder used for Start Work when a task names no other. A leading ~ means your home folder.
